_doc: difficulty 1-5 = n. Points: rejected +2n, accepted +n, choked -n. Streak = consecutive days with at least one Rejected/Yes. Scripted cards come first each day until all are done. Choked cards go back in the deck (backlog_chance).

scripted.title: What time is it?
scripted.text: Ask a stranger on the street for the time. Even if your phone is in your pocket.
scripted.tip: Walk up, open your mouth, survive. That's it.

scripted.title: Directions
scripted.text: Ask someone for directions to a nearby place (station, museum, café) and thank them.
scripted.tip: Actually listen to the answer instead of planning your exit.

scripted.title: Specific compliment
scripted.text: Give a sincere, specific compliment to a waiter, cashier or shop assistant.
scripted.tip: Specific beats generic: 'great wine pick' beats 'thanks, nice'.

scripted.title: The discount
scripted.text: When paying for a coffee or a pastry, ask if they could give you a small discount.
scripted.tip: You'll probably hear no. That's the point: smile and pay.

scripted.title: The photo
scripted.text: Ask a stranger to take a photo of you, then ask for a second one if you don't like it.
scripted.tip: Asking again is the real challenge.

pool.title: Book advice
pool.text: In a bookshop, ask the bookseller to recommend a book based on your tastes.

pool.title: Taste first
pool.text: At an ice cream shop, cheese shop or wine shop, ask to taste before choosing.

pool.title: Their favourite
pool.text: Ask the waiter what they would order in your place, and order it.

pool.title: Five hellos
pool.text: Say hello with a smile to five people you cross today.

pool.title: Glass of water
pool.text: Walk into a café and ask for a glass of water without ordering anything.

pool.title: The question
pool.text: Ask a question out loud during a lecture, meeting or talk.

pool.title: Where's it from?
pool.text: Ask someone where they bought an item or piece of clothing you like.

pool.title: Local tip
pool.text: Ask a shopkeeper for their favourite spot in the neighbourhood.

pool.title: Wrong shop
pool.text: Ask a shop for something it obviously doesn't sell (bread at the florist).

pool.title: Tip + 30 seconds
pool.text: Ask a stranger for a restaurant tip, then keep the conversation going for 30 seconds.

pool.title: Free sample
pool.text: Ask for a free sample in a shop that doesn't offer any.

pool.title: Swap seats
pool.text: Ask someone to swap seats with you (train, cinema, library).

pool.title: The request
pool.text: Ask a street musician to play a specific song.

pool.title: What are you reading?
pool.text: Ask someone reading in public what they're reading and whether they recommend it.

pool.title: Behind the scenes
pool.text: Ask a restaurant or bakery if you can have a quick look at the kitchen.

pool.title: The call
pool.text: Call a business and ask for a service they don't usually offer.

pool.title: The queue
pool.text: Start a conversation with someone in a queue and keep it going for at least a minute.

pool.title: Real advice
pool.text: Ask a stranger's opinion on a real decision you have to make.

pool.title: Haggle
pool.text: At a market or flea market, offer a specific price below the asking price.

pool.title: Join the group
pool.text: At a party or event, join a group that is already talking.

pool.title: Coffee?
pool.text: Invite an acquaintance you rarely see for a coffee this week.

pool.title: Teach me
pool.text: Ask someone to teach you something they can do in two minutes (juggling, a word in their language…).

pool.title: Upgrade
pool.text: Ask for an unplanned favour: a better table, a quieter room, a seat further up front.

pool.title: Study buddy
pool.text: Ask a classmate you barely know to study or work together.

pool.title: No excuse
pool.text: Approach a stranger without any particular reason and talk for at least two minutes.

pool.title: Fifteen minutes
pool.text: Ask a professor, researcher or professional whose work interests you for a 15-minute chat.

pool.title: Speak up
pool.text: Speak in front of a group (dinner, class, club) to thank someone or announce something.

pool.title: Stay in touch?
pool.text: After a good conversation with someone new, ask for their number or Instagram.

pool.title: Out of reach
pool.text: Write to someone you admire (author, athlete, researcher) with a real question.

pool.title: Walk-in application
pool.text: Walk into a company, lab or shop you like and ask if they take interns.

pool.title: Coffee, for real
pool.text: Ask someone you're attracted to out for a coffee or a drink.

pool.title: Just saying hi
pool.text: Go up to someone you're attracted to, say you wanted to introduce yourself, and see where it goes.

pool.title: The pitch
pool.text: Pitch one of your projects to a stranger and ask for their honest opinion.

pool.title: The big ask
pool.text: Ask for something important you've been putting off (a role, a raise, an opportunity).

pool.title: Game on
pool.text: Invite a group of strangers to play a game with you (cards, frisbee, quiz).
